**RACE dev accuracy is roughly 40% with 0 layers transferred and roughly 60% with all 12 layers.** The paper doesn't state these numbers. I read them from the plot in Figure 2 (left) on page 7, so treat them as approximate.

- **0 layers transferred:** about 40%. This is the leftmost point of the solid blue "RACE Dev" line, read against the left y-axis "RACE Dev Accuracy," which runs from 30 to 100.
- **12 layers transferred (full transfer):** about 60%. This is the rightmost point of the same line.

The text only gives a number for MultiNLI: each transformer layer adds benefit, "up to 9% for full transfer on MultiNLI" (page 7). It gives no RACE figures for this analysis.

Table 3 on page 6 reports 59.0 on RACE for the fine-tuned model. That is the overall benchmark result, not the dev-set figure in this plot, so it isn't a direct answer.
